verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 ships a software stack with documented 'API references' and model-serving guides, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question here. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.habana.ai all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
